title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the biling months of July, August and September, 1989. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its caluclation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
